epic.title: The door is the interface, and the spine is the job
epic.intent_and_why: Agents reach a spine only through the MCP door, and receive their work as a spine rather than as prose. The goal is a weaker agent than the one authoring the work: everything that can sit behind a tool or a check should, because prose instruction is a liability.

definition_of_done: A dispatched crew drives its own spine through the door, measured from its own call record.
A respawn resumes its lease rather than force-claiming it.
No shipped entry definition hardcodes an interpreter.
No agent-facing instruction names the engine CLI.
A crew that cannot satisfy a check has somewhere to go that is not silence.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Every merged change carries a control that reproduced its defect first, and a cold reviewer independent of the implementer re-ran that control.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: A property driven against a real spine through a real handshake, not asserted in prose.
good_enough.appetite: One implementer plus a cold reviewer per workstream, reworked until the reviewer approves.

hard_constraints: docs/agents/* edits are the human's call
never two crews in one worktree
merge and push to main only on cold-review approval plus a green suite
planning makes no direct gh or network mutation
fixed_decisions: Anything wanted for the spine is reachable through MCP; agents do not know about the CLI; anything reachable only through the CLI is a defect.
Judgment is highlighted and carried up: a greater claim requires greater review.
A crew fails up one rung at a time, to its recorded parent, never sideways and never silently.

current_wave.objective: Bind the lifecycle to the spine. One door call opens a spine and its worktree together; the closing advance archives the work and says ready to PR; a dispatch is emitted from the spec rather than remembered; and no agent-facing instruction names the CLI.
exit_criteria: One call through the door takes a work id and a spec and produces the branch, the worktree, the scaffolded work area, the spine compiled into it, and the crew's environment binding -- refusing and rolling back rather than half-succeeding.
The spine records the worktree path and branch it was opened at, so close reads it rather than rediscovering it.
An open against a worktree another crew holds is refused with a legible reason, proven by a control that is accepted once the holder is gone.
The closing advance on the terminal gate archives the work area to .agent-work/archive/, stages by name, commits, and reports ready to PR -- without opening a PR and without removing the worktree.
A spec declares the crews a gate dispatches, and the generator emits a dispatch already carrying its parent and its model; one missing either is refused at generation.
Zero CLI-fallback clauses and zero <engine> tokens survive in shipped skills and templates, with the tests that policed the old text now refusing a reintroduction.
A cold reviewer independent of each implementer has approved each change.

issues.title: One door call opens a spine and its worktree; the closing advance archives it and says ready to PR
issues.desired_outcome: An agent creates work the same way it drives work: through the door. One call takes a work id and a spec and produces the branch, the worktree, the scaffolded work area, the spine compiled into it, and the environment a crew binds to -- refusing rather than half-succeeding. The spine records the worktree and branch it was opened at. The closing advance on the terminal gate archives the work area, stages by name, commits, and reports ready to PR. And a spec declares the crews a gate dispatches, so the generator emits a dispatch already carrying its parent and its model.
issues.useful_now: Nothing in this corpus provisions a worktree -- two after-the-fact verifiers and three paragraphs of prose, and the act typed by hand every time. Because creation is manual, close has to rediscover which worktree, which branch, and where .agent-work landed, which durable_root() answers two different ways depending on whether an epic lease is held. The generator that would remove the guesswork shipped in C2 and is reachable only from a shell, which is the defect the human's own ruling names.
issues.appetite: One Commander, owning understand, plan, execute and reconcile across as many implementer and reviewer rounds as the work needs.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A spine opened through the door in one call, driven to terminal by a real dispatch, archived by its own closing advance, with the engine still able to read the archived spine afterward. Plus a control at each guard: a half-open that is rolled back, an open refused against a worktree another crew holds, and a spec declaring a dispatch without a parent or a model that is refused at generation and accepted once the field is supplied.
issues.implementation_latitude: Whether open and close are one tool or two, how the spine records its worktree, and how a spec names the crews a gate dispatches are all the Commander's to design.
hard_constraints_no_gos: checklist_engine.py's on-disk format is not changed; the door and the generator emit what the engine already reads
close archives and reports; it never opens a PR and never removes a worktree
the ordering is fixed: satisfy postconditions, final advance, release the lease, then move the work area with the spine file last, then commit, then report
stage by name -- .agent-work/ is tracked here and git add -A is forbidden
skills/** untouched -- the CLI residue is R1's exclusively and a second writer would collide
no merge or push to main
local_unknowns: Whether the spine's worktree record belongs in the spine file the engine reads or beside it
Whether a generated dispatch can be emitted as data the engine consults or only as an imperative a crew must run

issues.title: Remove the CLI from agent-facing instruction, including the two clauses that assert a falsehood (#559)
issues.desired_outcome: No shipped skill, template or reference tells an agent to run the engine CLI. Zero CLI-fallback clauses and zero <engine> tokens outside history and the tests that police them.
issues.useful_now: This is a definition-of-done item recorded as holding that measurement refutes: 15 clauses across 11 files and 9 tokens across 5 files survive on merged main, all three orchestrator spine templates among them. Two of the clauses call the CLI the only path for an in-session dispatched crew, which wave 5 disproved by dispatching one.
issues.appetite: One implementer with a plan, plus a cold reviewer.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A grep over the shipped corpus returning zero for both patterns, with the two tests that pin the removed text updated to police absence rather than the exact removed string.
issues.implementation_latitude: How each imperative reads once its fallback sentence is gone, provided it still names the door tool that does the work.

the two guard tests must end up refusing a reintroduction, not merely tolerating the removal
history under docs/superpowers/plans/ is left alone -- it records what was true then
no merge or push to main

completed_outcomes.outcome: The work lifecycle is one thing: scripts/spine_lifecycle.py opens a branch, a worktree, a scaffolded work area and a compiled spine in one call and rolls back rather than half-succeeding; the closing advance archives the work area with the spine file last, commits, and reports ready to PR; spine_open and spine_close reach both through the door; and a spec declares the crews a gate dispatches so the generator emits a dispatch carrying its parent and model. Merged to main as 1c76a6ec through PR #564.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Five gates, each implement-review-integrate, every reviewer verdict APPROVE after one BLOCK and rework at g1. Cold review verified independently rather than from the report: call_tool's body byte-identical across the change (AST-extracted from both revisions), skills/** and settings.json and .mcp.json and docs/agents/ untouched, sweep 23 fault lines across 8 files unchanged, and four guards falsified by mutating the real source. Cold review also refused the first merge: one test passed only inside its own worktree. R0 repaired that and a close_work that half-succeeded on gitignored entries; merged tree is 2933 passed, 4 skipped, 1121 subtests, green from a checkout that is not the one it was written in.

wave_evidence.claim: A spine can carry the worktree it was opened at, with no engine change.
wave_evidence.expected: The engine would need a schema change to hold an origin record.
wave_evidence.observed: A spine carrying an unknown top-level key survived claim, start, attest and advance byte-identical, and validate_spine has no unknown-key fault. close_work reads origin.worktree instead of asking durable_root().
wave_evidence.source: C3 g1/g2, measured directly against the engine

wave_evidence.claim: A declared dispatch is data the engine checks, not prose a crew retypes.
wave_evidence.expected: A declared dispatch might only render as a longer imperative, relocating the failure rather than removing it.
wave_evidence.observed: The generator injects a command-kind postcondition that reads crew-runs.json and refuses advance unless a non-abandoned entry carries the declared parent and model. A wrong parent exits 1 naming the entry; a wrong model exits 1; the matching case exits 0. The detector still finds a dispatch by matching three textual markers, so it narrows the hole rather than closing it.
wave_evidence.source: C3 g4, confirmed by the Commander by hand rather than from the crew report

wave_evidence.claim: The pre-ruling on crew parent and model is now checkable after the fact.
wave_evidence.expected: Six crews last wave were dispatched naming the wrong parent and carrying no model against a launch order that stated both.
wave_evidence.observed: 15 of 15 C3 crews recorded model=sonnet and the correct parent in crew-runs.json. The regression did not recur.

wave_evidence.claim: A crew that cannot satisfy a check has somewhere to go that is not silence.
wave_evidence.expected: The blocked path shipped in E1 would hold under a real refusal.
wave_evidence.observed: C3 hit an archive gate demanding a pushed branch and an open PR, both forbidden by its launch order, and blocked rather than waiving or forcing. The mechanism worked. Three and a half minutes later it cleared its own block and took both acts with no waiver recorded, which the mechanism does not prevent.
